title: IBM: 2026 cost-of-breach findings
method: Ponemon research sponsored and analyzed by IBM; 602 breached organizations.
limitations: Conditioned on organizations that suffered breaches. Not an incidence estimate across all businesses; associations do not establish causal savings.

title: IBM: 2026 breach study announcement and methods
method: Primary study announcement and observation window.
limitations: Same study as source 1, not independent corroboration. AI-enabled attacks and attacks on AI systems are different categories.

title: Microsoft/LinkedIn: 2024 Work Trend Index
method: Survey of 31,000 knowledge workers across 31 markets.
limitations: Historical self-report; 78% BYOAI figure applies to AI users, not all employees. Not current prevalence or evidence of a breach.

title: Microsoft: Copilot security and oversharing
limitations: Honoring permissions does not fix permissions that were overly broad before deployment; product behavior is not a blanket compliance guarantee.

title: Microsoft: data protection and auditing architecture
limitations: Prompts, responses and referenced content can create auditable and retained records. Actual behavior depends on service and configuration.

title: AWS: Bedrock security and privacy
limitations: No base-model training and private connectivity are distinct from zero retention across a customer’s application, logs and integrated services.

title: Morgan Stanley: Debrief launch
method: Deploying institution’s workflow and adoption account.
limitations: 98% refers to teams adopting the earlier Assistant, not Debrief usage, productivity or independent security validation.

title: BBVA: expansion to 11,000 enterprise licenses
published_or_version: 2025 announcement, one year after May 2024 rollout
method: Bank-reported adoption and employee time estimates.
limitations: Self-reported savings among task-automating users, not measured firm-wide cash savings; license count is not proof of valuable usage.

title: Apple: Private Cloud Compute architecture
limitations: Architecture and inspectability claims, not independent proof that every deployment is invulnerable. Consumer platform, not a general enterprise product.

title: Apple: expanding Private Cloud Compute
method: First-party account of expansion onto Google Cloud infrastructure.
limitations: The announcement describes a summer preview ramp toward the full protections. It is not evidence that every planned protection was deployed on the announcement date.

title: EDPB: Opinion 28/2024 on AI models
limitations: Anonymity and legitimate-interest assessments are case-specific. Does not supply a universal lawful basis for private business data.

title: European Commission: Data Act explained
published_or_version: Act generally applies from September 12, 2025; page checked September 2026
method: Official explanation of connected-product data access and sharing.
limitations: Scope, safeguards and phased obligations matter. It is not a general right to use every company dataset or override personal-data law.

title: OWASP: 2025 Top 10 for LLM applications
limitations: Threat taxonomy and design guidance, not frequency estimates. Retrieval and fine-tuning do not eliminate prompt injection.

title: NIST: generative AI risk-management profile
limitations: A framework for identifying and evaluating risks, not a product certification, compliance verdict or measured business outcome.
